[[File:Loan_shark.jpg|thumb|250px|The loan shark [[Yerkys ne Dago]] deals with a client.]]

'''Loan sharks''' were individuals who loaned [[Currency/Legends|money]] to other beings at very high interest rates and with very short payback periods. It was not uncommon for loan sharks to back up their demands for repayment with violence, hence their name.
